picker.drift_note: These menu entries differ from the catalogue — in target, action or required role. You decide which side is right: "Adopt structure" writes the catalogue value, "Keep live value" copies a note you can use to bring the catalogue up to date. Label, icon and order stay untouched either way.

picker.drift_keep_live_copied: Note copied. Pass it on so the catalogue gets updated — nothing changed here.

picker.profile_confirm: "{{profile}}" sets the selection to {{count}} blocks. Nothing is saved yet — you can adjust afterwards and still have to save. Continue?
